name: solidity-threshold-treasury
title: Threshold native treasury
description: Immutable-owner multisig treasury with transaction approvals, revocation, delay and exactly-once execution.
assumptions: Signer set and threshold are immutable. Delay starts at submission, not when quorum is reached. Calls can execute arbitrary target code after quorum; target failures revert execution and keep the transaction retryable. No signer rotation or signature-based approvals.
